items.title: Flood watches cover the Southwest ahead of a Four Corners heavy-rainfall event, U.S.
items.summary: Flood Watches are in effect across parts of Arizona, New Mexico, Utah and Colorado as successive Pacific moisture surges raise the flash-flood threat through early November 2, 2026. The Weather Prediction Center (WPC) has placed the Four Corners under a Moderate Risk of excessive rainfall for November 1, when it expects a high-impact heavy rainfall event over saturated ground. Source

items.title: Cyclone Arnab brings over 546 mm (21 inches) of rain, flooding isolates around 300 villages in Odisha, India
items.summary: Cyclone Arnab caused severe flooding across southern Odisha on October 29, 2026, after Patrapur in Ganjam district received 546 mm (21.5 inches) of rain in 24 hours. Around 300 villages were reported marooned in Ganjam, where the state planned to evacuate 120 people by helicopter in the first phase. Source

items.title: Lake Worth Pier and South Port Everglades reach record water levels, King tides flood Florida’s Atlantic coast
items.summary: King tides, persistent onshore winds and elevated seas caused coastal flooding along Florida's Atlantic coast from October 26 to 29, 2026. Preliminary water levels reached 0.82 m (2.70 feet) above mean higher high water at Lake Worth Pier and 0.76 m (2.48 feet) at South Port Everglades, both above the highest values in NOAA's current station tables. items.title: Strong and shallow M6.4 earthquake hits southeast of Easter Island
items.summary: A strong and shallow earthquake registered by the USGS as M6.4 hit southeast of Easter Island, Chile at 07:49 UTC on October 29, 2026. The agency is reporting a depth of 10 km (6.2 miles). EMSC is reporting M6.4 at a depth of 3 km (1.9 miles). Source
